title: Aamir Khan and Gauri Khan's Wedding Preparations Begin Amid Heavy Rain in Mumbai
summary: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan and his wife Gauri Khan are preparing for their wedding amidst heavy rain in Mumbai. The couple has been friends for over 25 years and have decided to tie the knot again after being apart for two years.
summary_points: Aamir Khan and Gauri Khan's wedding preparations have begun in Mumbai.
The couple has been friends for over 25 years and have decided to tie the knot again.
Heavy rain is expected to affect the wedding preparations.
The couple's home has been decorated with flowers and other decorations.
Aamir Khan has expressed his gratitude to his fans for their wishes.
title_hi: आमिर खान और गौरी खान की शादी की तैयारियां मुंबई में शुरू हुईं
